app.title: EEG Speech Decoder: classify one EEG epoch into a phoneme with a trained network
app.summary: A person either generates a synthetic EEG sample or uploads an EDF recording and processes it into one-second epochs. They pick which channels to plot and narrow the time window, so they can look at the raw signals. The trained CNN-LSTM model classifies the epoch. The person sees the predicted phoneme with its confidence, the probability for each class, and a scalp topography of activity. Saved training curves and a confusion matrix sit beside these, so the person can judge how far to trust the prediction.

task.text: Decode which speech sound a single multichannel EEG epoch corresponds to, and inspect the signal, scalp activity and model performance behind that prediction.

data.text: Multichannel scalp EEG cut into fixed-length epochs, either simulated or read from an EDF file. The data also includes a fixed set of class labels and saved model-evaluation figures.

stage.text: checking a trained decoder's predictions on single EEG epochs, after model training

mechanism.text: Sidebar controls load an epoch and choose which channels and time window to plot. The main area then redraws the signal traces and shows the model's prediction, its class probabilities and a scalp topomap for the same epoch. Static training-history and confusion-matrix images sit alongside as context.

field.text: deep-learning decoding of imagined speech from EEG in brain-computer interfaces

workflow.name: classify one recording with a trained model and inspect the evidence

steps.here: A radio button picks Synthetic or Real EEG. 'Generate New Sample' simulates one epoch. Otherwise the person uploads an EDF file and clicks 'Process EEG', which band-pass filters and resamples it, then cuts it into one-second epochs.

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: A multiselect of electrodes, labelled by scalp region, chooses which channels to plot. A slider limits the plot to a time range in milliseconds.
The selected channels are drawn as overlaid traces over the chosen window. A topographic scalp map shows the mean absolute activity at each electrode.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: The loaded CNN-LSTM classifies the epoch. A metric shows the predicted phoneme and its softmax confidence, and a bar chart shows the probability of every class. For synthetic samples, the sidebar also shows the true phoneme.

steps.step: check how far the result can be trusted
steps.here: Saved loss and accuracy curves and a confusion matrix from training are shown beside the prediction. If they are missing, a note says to run training first.

distinctive: Electrodes follow the 10-20 montage, so activity can be drawn as a scalp topography as well as traces.
Synthetic samples carry a known true class, so the person can check the prediction against the truth directly.
Real recordings are band-pass filtered and resampled, then cut into fixed one-second epochs before classification.
The prediction is shown next to the model's own training curves and confusion matrix, so the person can judge how far to trust it.

parts.title: Controls sidebar
parts.summary: Holds the controls that load an epoch and choose what to plot.

parts.title: Data source and loading
parts.summary: Switches between simulating an epoch and uploading an EDF file to process into epochs, then shows how old the sample is and, for synthetic data, its true phoneme.

parts.title: Channel and time-range selection
parts.summary: Lets the person pick which electrodes to plot, using region descriptions as a guide, and limit the plot to a time window.

parts.title: Neural signals
parts.summary: Plots the selected channels as overlaid traces over the chosen time range.

parts.title: Model prediction and class probabilities
parts.summary: Runs the trained classifier on the epoch and shows the predicted phoneme with its confidence, plus a bar for each class probability.

parts.title: Brain activation map
parts.summary: Draws the mean absolute activity at each electrode as a scalp topography on the 10-20 montage.

parts.title: Training history and confusion matrix
parts.summary: Shows the saved loss and accuracy curves and the confusion matrix, so the person can judge how far to trust the model, or a note to run training first if they are missing.
